sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Thulasilakshmi.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married to CW-1 on 26-5-2019 as per customs.
As per demand of accused, CW-1's parents have given gold ornaments and 3kgs of silver items to Accused No.1 and performed the marriage.

After the marriage,
CW-1 while residing with accused No.1, he demanded and harassed CW-1 to get further dowry of Rs.5 lakhs from parents of CW-1.
CW-1 and accused No.1 went to Ooty for honeymoon at that time, the accused No.1 had invited one Nandini and her husband to join and accused was talking to them.
CW-1 questioned the same, accused asked her to listen to him.
On 6-12-2019 accused have forced CW-1 to bring Rs.5 lakhs and attempted slit her throat  3  C.C.No.11570/2020 at 12.00 hours.
Due to unbearable torture, CW-1 went to her parents house at Konanakunte, Bangalore.

When panchayath was convened, accused abused CW 1 to 3, and tried to assault them and refused to take back CW-1 unless they give Rs.Five lakhs to them and thus subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.36/2020 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Thulasilakshmi vs Manjunatha on 1 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194742215/

Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty  4  C.C.No.11570/2020 and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her with dire consequences thereby  accused have committed the offences punishable  U/s.498A, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P. Act.?

sentences.text:
My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.11570/2020  REASONS  9.
POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Thulasilakshmi.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 26-05-2019 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.

During which PW-1  6 Thulasilakshmi vs Manjunatha on 1 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194742215/
4  C.C.No.11570/2020 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

sentences.text: 11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A,
C.C.No.11570/2020 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 3 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
